description: Election Commission - E. W. A. Chandradasa was elected as the member of the Thawalama Pradeshiya Sabaha - D. M. C. Indika was elected as the member of the Arachchikattuwa Pradeshiya Sabaha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Thawalama Pradeshiya Sabha and Arachchikattuwa Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for declaring elected members to fill seats that became vacant due to death and party membership cessation. This falls directly under election-related matters, specifically addressing candidate nominations and declarations of elected members for local authority positions.
